simple.meaning: an apple (from its fragrance), i.e. the fruit or the tree (probably includ. others of the pome order, as the quince, the orange, etc.)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to תַּפּוּחַ (H8598) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 6 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: תַּפּוּחַ (tappûwach) means an apple (from its fragrance), i.e. the fruit or the tree (probably includ. others of the pome order, as the quince, the orange, etc.) First listed occurrence: Joel 1 12.

definitions.short: an apple (from its fragrance), i.e. the fruit or the tree (probably includ. others of the pome order, as the quince, the orange, etc.)
definitions.full: H8598. tappuach I. תַּמּוּחַ noun [masculine] apple-tree, apple (from aromatic scent (breath), Thes Lag BN 111, 129 Post (see below); Arabic is loan-word Frä 140 ; on meaning apple see Löw No. 109 RS JPh xiii. 65 f. Post Hast. Dict. Bib. 'Apple' ) **see also Hom A. u. A. 100, 106, 107 ; Tristr NHB 334 f. thinks ׳ת = apricot (so Id. Smith DB (2) APPLE ); M'Lean-Dyer EB APPLE makes ׳ת = quince . — 1 singular תַּמּוּחַ apple-tree Joel 1:12 ; Song 2:3 ; 8:5 . 2 plural תַּמּוּחִים apples Song 2:5 , כַּתּ אַמֵּךְ ׳רֵיחַ 7:9 ; זָהָב תַּמּוּחֵי Prov 25:4 (in simile).
